steps.say: A code is hidden in the clock tower. Ask me what time it is.
It is half past three. Tell me when your class starts.
steps.ar: قل: My class starts at nine

steps.say: The train leaves soon. Tell me you are late.
Agent, tell me about your family. How many people are in your family?
steps.ar: قل: There are five people in my family

steps.say: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
What does your father do?
steps.ar: قل: My father is a teacher

steps.say: Which school subject do you like best?
Why do you like it?
The lesson is hard. Tell your teacher you do not understand.
What is the weather like today?
What is your favorite season?
steps.ar: قل: My favorite season is summer

steps.say: It is very cold outside. What do you wear?
Welcome to the market! What do you want to buy?
steps.ar: قل: I would like some apples

steps.say: How many kilos do you want?
That is ten dollars. Ask if you can pay by card.
steps.ar: قل: Can I pay by card?

steps.say: Next in line, please. What can I do for you?
steps.ar: قل: One ticket to the city, please

steps.say: Single or return?
Here is your ticket. Ask which platform the train leaves from.
What do you like to do in your free time?
How often do you do it?
steps.ar: قل: Every day / Twice a week

steps.say: Now ask me about my hobbies.
steps.ar: اسأل: What do you like to do?

steps.say: Describe the suspect. Is he tall or short?
What color is his jacket?
Where did you see him?
steps.ar: قل: I saw him near the station

steps.say: What did you do yesterday?
Where did you go?
steps.ar: قل: I went to the market

steps.say: Did you enjoy it?

title: Future Agent
skill: المستقبل (I will / I am going to)

steps.say: What will you do tomorrow?
Where are you going to travel one day?
steps.ar: قل: I am going to visit Turkey

steps.say: What job do you want in the future?
steps.ar: قل: I want to be a teacher
